from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
root = Path('.')
files = [
    'docs/roles/ProductDesigner/feature-map.md',
    'docs/roles/ProductDesigner/functional-description.md',
    'docs/roles/ProductDesigner/api-spec.md',
    'docs/roles/ProductDesigner/changelog.md',
    'docs/roles/ProductDesigner/docs/design/2026-10-08_design_legion-ui.md',
    'docs/roles/ProductDesigner/prototypes/legion-ui.html',
]
missing = [name for name in files if not (root / name).is_file() or (root / name).stat().st_size == 0]
assert not missing, f'missing or empty design deliverables: {missing}'
assert all(Path(name).parts[:3] == ('docs', 'roles', 'ProductDesigner') for name in files), 'design write scope escaped ProductDesigner docs'

class PrototypeParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.inline_scripts = []
        self.script_depth = 0
        self.current_script = []
        self.errors = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        values = dict(attrs)
        if tag in {'iframe', 'object', 'embed'}:
            self.errors.append(f'embedded active content: {tag}')
        if tag == 'script':
            if 'src' in values:
                self.errors.append('script src must be inline in the scoped prototype')
            self.script_depth += 1
            self.current_script = []
        for name in ('src', 'href', 'action', 'formaction', 'poster', 'data', 'xlink:href'):
            value = values.get(name, '').strip()
            if value and (value.startswith('//') or re.match(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:', value, re.I)):
                if not (name == 'src' and value.lower().startswith('data:image/')):
                    self.errors.append(f'external or file resource in {name}')

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'script' and self.script_depth:
            self.inline_scripts.append(''.join(self.current_script))
            self.current_script = []
            self.script_depth -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.script_depth:
            self.current_script.append(data)

html = (root / files[-1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
parser = PrototypeParser()
parser.feed(html)
parser.close()
assert not parser.errors, f'prototype includes out-of-scope external/embedded resources: {parser.errors}'
source = '\n'.join(parser.inline_scripts)
for pattern, label in [
    (r'\bfetch\s*\(', 'fetch'),
    (r'\bXMLHttpRequest\b', 'XMLHttpRequest'),
    (r'\b(WebSocket|EventSource)\b', 'network stream API'),
    (r'\b(sendBeacon|ipcRenderer|contextBridge)\b', 'network or IPC API'),
    (r'window\s*\.\s*(legionDesktop|api)\b', 'desktop bridge'),
    (r'\b(require|import)\s*\(?\s*[\"\']electron\b', 'Electron runtime access'),
]:
    assert not re.search(pattern, source, re.I), f'prototype inline JavaScript references {label}'
for script in parser.inline_scripts:
    result = subprocess.run(['node', '--check', '--input-type=module'], input=script, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    assert result.returncode == 0, f'prototype JavaScript syntax check failed: {result.stderr.strip()}'
print('Six scoped design deliverables exist and are nonempty; prototype local UI JavaScript syntax checked without execution, with bounded static checks for external resources and direct desktop/network APIs.')
